title: Great stuff
text:
So...
The experience was a blast. We were warmly welcomed and—I have to say—guided through the experience with incredible calm and serenity.
The cherry on top of the massive buttercream cake was the finale. We were given the choice between a tasty beer or the absolute best tea ever. We were both sick, so we went with the tea. Highly recommended. 
One small critique: it was pretty pricey.

title: Super activity, perfect for our group of deaf
text:
EVG incredible with our group of 8 deaf people!

The samurai activity was really great. 

The young man who led the activity quickly understood how to communicate with us. He showed us the gestures clearly with the sword, with demonstrations and facial expressions, so we understood very easily.

The atmosphere was great and very fun. He also let us make some jokes for the EVG. I’m the witness and I’m really happy to have chosen this activity for this special day.

Thank you for this moment, I really recommend this activity!

title: Great samurai experience in Barcelona
text:
A fantastic family experience. The activity is very well organized and the instructor is very friendly, patient and passionate. We loved dressing up in traditional costume and discovering the world of samurai in a fun and educational way. The whole family has had a great time and learned a lot.
An original and highly recommended plan in Barcelona!
